agent-instructions.objective: Conduct the Bridge of Death trial for the verified knight. Ask the three questions, take the knight's answers, and have the Bridgekeeper judge them. If all three are correct, the knight crosses and the trial is recorded as passed. If any is wrong, the knight is cast into the Gorge of Eternal Peril — never let a wrong answer across.

contract.fizzbee:
--- deadlock_detection: false liveness: "false" options: max_concurrent_actions: 1 ---
# ---- State ---- action Init: questions_asked = False answers_given = False answers_correct = oneof [True, False] # judged in code by the Bridgekeeper crossed = False cast_into_gorge = False
atomic action AskThreeQuestions: require not questions_asked questions_asked = True
atomic action ReceiveAnswers: require questions_asked require not answers_given answers_given = True answers_correct = oneof [True, False]
atomic action Cross: require answers_given require answers_correct require not crossed require not cast_into_gorge crossed = True
# ---- Fallback: a wrong answer -> the Gorge of Eternal Peril ---- atomic action CastIntoGorge: require answers_given require not answers_correct require not crossed require not cast_into_gorge cast_into_gorge = True
# ---- Invariants ---- # The knight is never across without having answered all three questions. always assertion ThreeQuestionsBeforeCrossing: return (not crossed) or answers_given
# The knight never crosses on a wrong answer. always assertion NoCrossingWithWrongAnswer: return (not crossed) or answers_correct
# One cannot both cross and be cast into the Gorge. always assertion NeverBothCrossAndGorge: return (not crossed) or (not cast_into_gorge)

promises.description: Conducts the Bridge of Death: asks the three questions, has the Bridgekeeper judge the answers in code, and lets the knight cross only if all three are correct — otherwise casts them into the Gorge of Eternal Peril. Never crosses a wrong answer.

offer.body: Let the verified knight cross the Bridge of Death and record the trial as passed — only when all three answers are correct.
The promised fallback: a wrong or wavering answer casts the knight into the Gorge of Eternal Peril — never a silent pass.
No knight crosses on a wrong answer; correctness is decided by the Bridgekeeper's canonical answers in code (NoCrossingWithWrongAnswer).

use.body: The verified knight attempting the crossing.
The three questions and the knight's correct answers; the Bridgekeeper judges the given answers against these.
Records the Bridge of Death as passed, keyed to the verified knight.

step-guidance.binding: Call get_bridge_questions and ask them, in order: name, quest, favourite colour. (For the truly bold, the Bridgekeeper may ask the airspeed velocity of an unladen swallow — mind whether it is African or European.)
Collect the knight's three answers, then call judge_crossing(name, quest, favourite_colour). Do NOT decide correctness yourself — the Bridgekeeper's code judges against the registry.
Only if judge_crossing returns crossed=true, tell the knight they may cross; the trial is recorded as passed.
If judge_crossing returns crossed=false, relay the Gorge response — the knight is cast into the Gorge of Eternal Peril. Do not retry the same wrong answer.

agent-instructions.enforcement: The service layer enforces these independently of the LLM: judge_crossing records a crossing only when all three answers match the Bridgekeeper's canonical answers. judge_crossing requires all three answers to be supplied.

responses.crossed: Right. Off you go. You may cross the Bridge of Death.
responses.gorge: AAAAAAAAAUGH! — Wrong. Into the Gorge of Eternal Peril with you.
